local_conclusions: Conditional prefix masking improved coherence23to35 but failed historical Web BPB; masked interleaving retained Web BPB but failed generation. These are observed tradeoffs, not a confirmed single cause.

Inspected prefix-mask/context-substitution/InfoNCE/source-order implementations do not perform generative prefix-suffix-middle reordering. This is bounded mechanism inspection, not proof all research history lacks FIM.
The24 draws resolve structural byte conservation and immediate context cost only. They do not establish sufficient training horizon or an AR-quality gain.
